subject: k-class
notes: Builder general arrangement (private), IC16112 plan. The image is private and is not stored in Git. Sheet explicitly says NOT TO SCALE: longitudinal and transverse calibration use separate printed dimensions, and unprinted plan measurements are tentative. Heights are low-confidence simulator estimates because no K-class profile is supplied. All heights use waterline y=0; z=0 is half LOA. No safety-system details or drawing artwork are reproduced. Reference-import numeric picks merged into exterior layout; additional coarse points and visual details remain estimates. Sponson projection is unresolved; the provisional model extends 0.16 m per side including rubber beyond the printed beam, an explicit low-confidence visual placeholder. Neutral palette is simulator art direction.

beam.note: Printed dimension: 8.5 m; not a pixel-derived value. Printed beam excludes sponsons; transverse calibration anchor.

upper_deck_height.note: Unmeasured K-class assumption: estimated main deck 2.5 m plus T-class 2.4 m deck rise. Needs K-class profile.

wheelhouse_roof_height.note: Unmeasured K-class assumption: estimated upper deck 4.9 m plus T-class 2.4 m roof rise. Needs K-class profile.

bow_height.note: Unmeasured assumption: published depth 3.5 m corresponds to main-deck elevation above baseline, less 1.0 m hull draft. Verify datum and deck camber. Foredeck assumed level with main-deck datum; camber is unresolved.

underwing_height.note: Unmeasured visual placeholder, 0.7 m below the estimated main deck. Needs K-class profile or crew measurement.
